ability.name: Targeted Service Port Scan
ability.description: Conduct dynamic TcpClient connection scanning against known directory service and controller ports on verified live targets.

stages.command_template: $d='C:\Windows\Temp\bas'; if(!(Test-Path $d)){New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $d | Out-Null}; $(try { $error.Clear(); $hostsFile = 'C:\Windows\Temp\bas\live_hosts.txt'; if (!(Test-Path $hostsFile)) { throw 'live_hosts.txt missing' }; $hosts = Get-Content $hostsFile; $ports = @(88,389,445); $results = @(); foreach ($ip in $hosts) { foreach ($port in $ports) { $tcp = New-Object System.Net.Sockets.TcpClient; try { $c = $tcp.BeginConnect($ip, $port, $null, $null); if ($c.AsyncWaitHandle.WaitOne(200, $false)) { $tcp.EndConnect($c); Write-Output "OPEN: $ip`:$port"; $results += @{ip=$ip; port=$port; service=$(if($port -eq 88){'kerberos'}elseif($port -eq 389){'ldap'}else{'microsoft-ds'})} } } catch {} finally { $tcp.Dispose() } } }; $results | ConvertTo-Json | Out-File C:\Windows\Temp\bas\services.json -Encoding ascii } catch { "ERROR: $_" }) | Tee-Object -FilePath C:\Windows\Temp\bas\step5.txt

rationale: Allows targeted enumeration of DC ports without noisy massive sweeps.
